why: mlx-lm's OpenAI-compatible server, mlx_lm.server, which runs on the Apple Silicon GPU through MLX. It reads its tool-call and reasoning formats from the model's tokenizer, so a profile needs no parser flags. It has no API key and binds 127.0.0.1 by default, so the command leaves the host alone: listening beyond this machine is a choice to make in EXTRA_ARGS, knowing the endpoint is then open.

install.any: uv venv ~/venvs/mlx && uv pip install mlx-lm
